scripts.lint: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),{execSync}=require('child_process');const exts=new Set(['.js','.mjs','.cjs']);const skip=new Set(['node_modules','.git','dist','build','coverage']);const targets=['core','start.js'];let fail=0,count=0;function walk(p){const st=fs.statSync(p);if(st.isDirectory()){if(skip.has(path.basename(p)))return;for(const f of fs.readdirSync(p))walk(path.join(p,f));}else if(exts.has(path.extname(p))){count++;try{execSync('node --check '+JSON.stringify(p),{stdio:['ignore','ignore','pipe']});}catch(e){fail++;console.error('SYNTAX ERROR:',p);process.stderr.write(e.stderr||e.message);}}}for(const t of targets){if(fs.existsSync(t))walk(t);}console.log('lint: checked '+count+' files, '+fail+' error(s)');process.exit(fail?1:0);"
scripts.format: node -e "try{require.resolve('prettier');const{execSync}=require('child_process');execSync('npx prettier --write \"core/**/*.js\" \"start.js\"',{stdio:'inherit'});}catch(e){console.log('format: prettier not installed, skipping (install with: npm i -D prettier)');}"
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run build:dashboard
scripts.clean: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');const dist='dashboard-client/dist';if(fs.existsSync(dist)){fs.rmSync(dist,{recursive:true,force:true});console.log('clean: removed',dist);}const snaps='data/snapshots';if(fs.existsSync(snaps)){const cutoff=Date.now()-30*24*60*60*1000;let n=0;for(const f of fs.readdirSync(snaps)){const p=path.join(snaps,f);try{if(fs.statSync(p).mtimeMs<cutoff){fs.rmSync(p,{recursive:true,force:true});n++;}}catch{}}console.log('clean: removed',n,'snapshot(s) >30d');}else{console.log('clean: no data/snapshots dir');}"
